That was Interschutz

01 - 06 June 2026

 

Everything for that moment.

Everything for that moment.

On a display area of more than 3,700 m², Rosenbauer showcased the full range of modern firefighting technology with over 600 exhibits. The highlight was the L32A-XS electric aerial ladder on MAN’s new eTGM chassis. The vehicle combines Rosenbauer’s proven aerial ladder technology with the advantages of zero-emission and exceptionally quiet operation. With a gross vehicle weight of less than 16 tons and a rear axle load of under 10 tons, the vehicle is the first to fall below the weight limits applicable to fire department staging areas in Germany as well as the relevant performance standard DIN EN 14043 for Class 23/12 aerial ladders.

 

There was also great interest in the L43A-XS aerial ladder as well as innovations in the areas of technical equipment and personal protective equipment. In addition to the portable battery-powered RTE LX lighting system, which has been comprehensively further developed in terms of design and function, equipment innovations in the areas of fire suppression systems, thermal imaging technology, and battery-powered ventilation systems were presented.

In the area of personal protective equipment, the focus was primarily on products designed for demanding operational conditions.

The GLOROS F50 glove, developed primarily for indoor firefighting, combines the highest protection standards with excellent ergonomics. The robust material offers reliable protection against flames, heat, and chemicals even under extreme conditions.

The new BOROS B10 firefighting boot combines minimal weight with high off-road capability and uncompromising protection. It was specifically designed to meet the demands of wildland firefighting. When every second counts, the BOROS B4 Cross also proves particularly valuable. This advanced boot, featuring a low shaft and an innovative quick-release fastening system, allows for quick donning and a secure fit.

System solutions instead of individual products.

  • System solutions.

    From vehicles to digital control systems.

    Everything from a single source. Uniform operating concepts. Integrated solutions. For airports, municipalities, industry, and wildfires.

  • Field-tested.

    Products that prove themselves in use.

    Our innovations are in use—and prove their performance every day under real operating conditions.

  • Customer-focused.

    Meet our international teams, discuss your challenges, and discover practical solutions. Experience live demonstrations, the RTE Robot Parcours, simulators, the community fan zone, coffee truck, and brand experience.

Community Fanzone

The Rosenbauer Fanzone served as a gathering place for the international firefighting community at Interschutz 2026. In a relaxed atmosphere, away from the hustle and bustle of the trade show, it provided a space for networking, socializing, and one-on-one conversations.
In addition to free snacks and drinks, a special highlight was the Fire Dept. Coffee Truck from the U.S., which attracted numerous visitors. Furthermore, the shared exchange of patches at the Patch Exchange Wall made the Fanzone a visible symbol of global solidarity among emergency responders.

The Interschutz trade show

Interschutz 2026 in Hanover once again confirmed its global significance as the leading trade fair for firefighting, rescue services, and safety. Six days marked by innovation, intensive dialogue, and powerful inspiration.

With around

  • 140,000 visitors
  • from 144 countries, 1,772 exhibitors, and
  • over 800 premieres

the event demonstrated its exceptional diversity and quality. Particularly memorable were the numerous encounters and the palpable strength of international partnerships.
